train_vqa_model: train a VQA model for EmbodiedQA using the VQATrainer class with LSTM CNN attention architecture
eval_vqa_checkpoint: evaluate a VQA model checkpoint on validation data and compute accuracy and mean rank metrics
save_vqa_results: save VQA prediction results as images showing questions, predicted answers, and ground truth answers
create_vqa_dataset: create an EQADataset for VQA input type with shuffled episodes and image frame queues
review_vqa_trainer: review the VQATrainer class and its training loop for Visual Question Answering in embodied AI tasks
